overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating image captioning evaluation metrics, particularly examining gender biases. It uses FIBER as the main generation model and evaluates various metrics on multiple datasets. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric names and removal of evaluation metrics incorrectly listed as models under question 1.
